notes.title: Major FREE Update ‘Shrimplosion’ update is OUT!
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]It’s been a while since our last post, because we’ve been busy cooking something special for you![/p][p]We’re so excited to share our brand-new [b]free Update ‘Shrimplosion[/b]’- this one’s for those of you who love tiny pet chaos (and that [url="https://youtu.be/YOwUIn1E0S4?feature=shared"][u]space shrimp video[/u][/url])![/p][p][/p][p]You can see the famous Shrimp band in action in the trailer below:[/p][previewyoutube="nPnQTyrqoFo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]Here’s what’s swimming your way:[/p][list][*][p]🦐 [b]The Shrimplosion is in town[/b]! A legendary music band of 4 shrimps can now be obtained, and will even start playing their hit song once they’re placed in your aquarium. [/p][/*][*][p][b]💰 New shop tab,[/b] with a wide array of items (including mutators 👀) and exclusive decorations![/p][/*][*][p]🐚 [b]Fishing cosmetics shop, [/b]where you can buy cool new ship skins and effects using shells![/p][/*][*][p]🐠 [b]15 new fish and shellfish species[/b], including the sea bunny 🐰
(Full list: Blue Crayfish, Amano Shrimp, Babaulti Shrimp, Blue Velvet Shrimp, Crystal Red Shrimp, Ghost Shrimp, Mantis Shrimp, Common Jellyfish, Flying Fish, Sea Bunny, Magical Magmafish, and The Shrimplosion band!).[/p][/*][*][p]🎁 [b]15 new tank decorations
(Full list: [/b]Golden Chest, Blue Crystal, Pink Crystal, Runic Stone, Rock Cave, Clay Pot, Moss Balls, Stacked Stones, and 5 New Seaweed and wood Types).[/p][/*][*][p]🧼 Introducing the Instaclean: a new tank tool that’ll clean your aquarium in one swipe[/p][/*][*][p][b]🎉 +1 new aquarium tank[/b]![/p][/*][*][p]📍 [b]New quests[/b], and a bigger quest pool! [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]We’ve also had a lot of requests for it, so we’re bringing back the time-limited Axolotl Event! If you didn’t get one before, now is your chance to make your tank that much cuter! ♥️[/p][p]As always, we would like to extend a huge [b]thank you[/b] to our amazing community. Your creations and feedback are always a source of inspiration for our updates 🙂. We can’t wait to see how you customise your tanks, now with tiny concerts!

[/p][p]Best fishes!
- Can & Egon from the Lunheim Team 🐙[/p]

notes.title: 1.6.1 Now Live
notes.content:
[h1]**Tiny Aquarium – Update 1.6.1 Now Live! ** 
[/h1][p]
[b]Tiny Aquarium 1.6.1 is now officially live! [/b]Thanks to everyone who helped test during the beta phase. Here’s what’s new in this mostly bug-fixing update:  [/p][h2]**Added**[/h2][p]- Ability to move Tiny Mode to another monitor.

- A new reaction type that is unlimited, but doesn't give shells. (Yuppie!)

- Credits screen.

[/p][h2]**Fixes**[/h2][p]- Broken achievements now work correctly.

- Demo players can now receive upgrade achievements.

- Fixed sound volume issues.

- Featured aquarium now functions properly.

- Weekly quests now reset correctly. (We had to force a reset!)

- Castle decoration no longer floats.

- Fixed visual bugs with the discus fish.

- Fixed daily quest reward disappearing if the aquarium is full.

- Corrected the name for Snail Garden.

- Fixed a server-side issue preventing some players from publishing fish or receiving visitors.

[/p][h2]**Changes**[/h2][p]- Large Time Potion stack count increased to 5.

- Coral fish are now bigger.

- Made rarity text in the online market consistent with the fish list.

- Updated the shop description for Time Potions.

- Increased the per-aquarium decoration cap from 100 to 200.


[i]Minor known issue: The unlimited reaction displays a different visual when used. This will be patched very soon.[/i][/p]

notes.title: A “Thank YOU!” content update 🙂 New fish, new decorations
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,
[/p][p]What a wild week it’s been!
[/p][p]Since launching on Monday, we’ve already sold over 25,000 copies, and our little aquarium game now has more than 400 reviews with a [i]“Very Positive”[/i] rating on Steam 🥰
[/p][p]Your warm reception has been truly humbling. We honestly never expected so many of you would play our cozy little game - in fact, things got [i]so[/i] unexpectedly busy that our servers crashed, and Egon had to pull an all-nighter to fix them!
To make up for it, we’ll be[b] extending the Axolotl event for an extra week[/b] so nobody misses out because of the hiccups.
[/p][p]We’ve loved meeting some of you in the fishing lobbies and visiting your aquariums, and we thought the best way to say THANK YOU is with a[b] little extra content drop[/b]! 🙂[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914647/97870eebc3db465d08897050b03b6fb8d565a9f6.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914647/4c7545fbbb78d187f5e5adee05ba396e1593f108.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914647/44a9e7ab94acbbe2fef2dd4331365eca7f700cc1.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914647/bed3d025ce2d6b454d7ed61e8a089a2804e8c696.gif"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914647/73c8fa8c2167a509fb3b67254251635f2ba1602d.gif"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]With this very first content update, you’ll find [b]new fish [/b]and [b]new decorations[/b] to unlock:[/p][list][*][p]🦈 Sturgeon fish[/p][/*][*][p]🐟 Bluegill fish[/p][/*][*][p]🏮 Lantern[/p][/*][*][p]🌺 Sea anemone[/p][/*][*][p]🗡️ Aquacalibur!  [/p][/*][/list][p][i]All of this new content is exclusive to fishing![/i][/p][p][/p][p]We’re also working hard behind the scenes, pushing patches and fixes every day. Thank you so much for your patience!  We’re committed to ironing out the remaining issues as quickly as possible!
[/p][p]If you haven’t left a review yet, we’d really appreciate it - reviews make a big difference in helping Tiny Aquarium reach more players ❤️ [/p][p]Best fishes, and see you soon with more Tiny Aquarium content!
 - Can & Egon from the Lunheim Team 🐙[/p]

notes.title: 1.5 Now Available For Early Testing!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello Fishkeeper!

 [b]v1.5 is live for testing![/b] [/h3][p]
From now on, every patch will first go to a public [i]beta branch[/i] a few hours [i](or a day for big updates)[/i] before the main version. Players who want early access and can help test are welcome to join. Use ⁠public-beta-feedback to give us feedback and report bugs. 

[b]To access the beta: [/b]Right-click Tiny Aquarium in your Steam library → Properties → Betas → Select "publicbeta" from the dropdown.

 If you join the beta to help us find bugs, [b]we recommend making a backup of your save file beforehand[/b].
You can find it here:
%USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Lunheim Studios/Tiny Aquarium 

[b]If you received any new content in the beta branch of 1.5, do not switch back to the public branch until the 1.5 update is public. If you really want to, use your backup save in case anything goes wrong.[/b]

notes.title: Get your time-limited Axolotl before July 7th!

[p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]We’re typing this down while we’re both overhyped and exhausted after launching the game earlier today 🥳Thank you so much for the warm reception, you have no idea how much it means to us to see the lobbies filled with people, chatting, sharing and fishing![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914647/ba935fbf04e3154c36901ce5add708c5f41c197a.png"][/img][/p][p]Also, today marks the [b]first day of our time-limited season event[/b],  the “A-lotl Axolotl”! This seasonal currency can be spent on the [b]reward shop for curious exclusive decorations, items, and of course, the Axolotl Egg[/b]![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44914647/ad55e1c8af837e89524a5361339e00a3efa0b80f.png"][/img][/p][p]I’m not sure how much you love these weird little critters, but we do!!! 🙂 Their name apparently translates from an aztec language to mean ‘water dog’ and who doesn’t love dogs?[/p][p]
That’s all for now, but before we leave you, we do have a small request - if you’re playing the game, would you [b]consider leaving us a review[/b]? The mighty Steam algorithm puts a lot of importance on them, and this can make such a difference for small teams and projects like ours!

Best fishes and see you soon for more aquatic updates!

notes.title: Welcome to Tiny Aquarium!
notes.content:
Hello all,

We are Lunheim Studios and this is our brand new game Tiny Aquarium: Social Fishkeeping! 

[previewyoutube=f8amATSCcq0;full][/previewyoutube]

Tiny Aquarium is a real-time idle aquarium sim that keeps growing even when you’re away! It can also accompany you throughout the day in a small box anywhere on your screen when in Tiny Mode, so you will never feel alone as you browse!

We’re super excited to be officially announcing this new  project, with a demo that you can go check out right now!! We’re also joined by Future Friends Games, who are helping us publish Tiny Aquarium 🧡

What you can expect from the demo:
[list]
[*] A place to create your dream aquarium, discovering new species of fish and unlocking new decorations to make them feel at home.
[*] A chilled hangout spot for you and your friends where you can visit each other's tanks and leave a reaction to let them know you popped by!
[*] A comforting companion on your screen, where fishies peacefully swim and enjoy your creation!
[*] Oh and A FISHING MINI GAME! 🎣
[/list]

We really hope you enjoy this demo, make sure to wishlist the game so that you get notified with more updates, and follow us on [url=https://www.tiktok.com/@tinyaquariumgame]Tiktok [/url]& [url=https://x.com/AquariumTiny]Twitter [/url]for more Tiny Aquarium content! 💌

Talk soon!
The Lunheim Team



[b]Played the older version of the demo?[/b]
No worries, your old aquarium is still safe! To access it, simply switch to the "legacy" branch. Here’s how:
[list]
[*] Open your Steam Library and find Tiny Aquarium.

[*] Right-click the game title and select Properties.

[*] Go to the Betas tab.

[*] In the dropdown menu, select "legacy".

[*] Close the window. Steam will automatically update your game to the legacy version.

Now you can revisit your original tank just as you left it!
